_comment: Radio playlists. Drop audio files (mp3/ogg/m4a/wav) into this folder and list them here. `station` says which dial position a track belongs to — "uncle" for 98.8 UNCLE SQUATCH BEATS, "ksqch" for 101.7 KSQCH. Leave it out and the track lands on the first music station. Each station plays its own list in order and loops; a station with no tracks tunes to static and says why.

tracks._comment: Plays from the top and gets exactly 15 seconds before the station cuts it dead for the meeting notice. `start` pins it to 0 so the 15s is the recording's 15s, not 15s from wherever the usual random drop-in landed.
